question: What universal range must be encompassed when meditating on that reality in every place?
premises: Meditation is performed in place after place.
The object of meditation extends from Śiva down to Avīci.
inference: One should meditate on that reality everywhere as pervading the entire range from Śiva to Avīci.
plain_english: Having meditated on that in every place, as extending from Śiva down to Avīci,
